messages:
rachel: Heads-up: several onboarding runs failed this morning for new signups using Next/Edge and Cloudflare after we shipped @redwood/sdk 2.0.0. Error is at the ESM import boundary in edge handlers: `TypeError: Redwood.default is not a function`.

rachel: Local node and serverless node tests were fine, only edge runtimes (CF Pages, Vercel Edge) and some bundler configs hit it.

theo: Sounds like an exports map resolution mismatch. Did we change to a single-path exports to dedupe files? Those make resolver heuristics pick the wrong file for ESM consumers.

maya: quick look at package.json in the release tag: "exports": { ".": "./lib/index.js", "./package.json": "./package.json" } and we left main pointing at `lib/index.cjs`. The .js is a CJS build but some bundlers/edges treat .js as ESM and call the default.

dan: yep. Also our d.ts generator emitted `export =` style types this release, so TS projects that do `import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'` see mismatch. A bunch of support tickets referencing puzzling runtime/typing errors.

rachel: Repro we used: install 2.0.0 in sample-apps, create an edge handler `import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'` and run edge emulator -> fails on import.

theo: short-term: pin sample-apps CI to 1.9.x and add a tiny edge import smoke: `await import('@redwood/sdk')` in a matrix job so new SDK publishes fail fast.

maya: long-term fix: publish a patch that uses conditional export targets: "exports": { ".": { "import": "./esm/index.mjs", "require": "./cjs/index.cjs", "node": "./node/index.cjs" }, "./package.json": "./package.json" }. Also ensure ESM build uses .mjs or set `type` per subpath.

dan: agree. Also update `types` to point to an ESM-compatible d.ts if we publish ESM typings, and configure our DTS generator to emit `export default` when we intend a default import.

theo: I can prep a 2.0.1 patch with corrected exports and updated types. Suggest we add a prepublish smoke that runs `node -e "import('@redwood/sdk').then(()=>console.log('esm ok'))"` and `node -e "console.log(require('@redwood/sdk'))"` to catch both resolution paths.

rachel: good call. And let's add a checklist entry in the release playbook: verify conditional exports + types sanity + edge smoke green.

maya: I'm adding a short DX doc for package exports and edge runtimes (examples: node, esbuild, rollup, vercel, cloudflare) and will link it from the SDK README. PR incoming.

dan: I'll add a unit test in the SDK infra that verifies the published package.json exports permutations (import/require/node) using a temp install.

theo: publishing 2.0.1 now with fixes and prepublish checks enabled. will post the npm link when available.

release-bot: release-2.0.1 build started (job id r-2103) :rocket:

rachel: Once patch is out I'll re-run the onboarding matrix for sample-apps. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround — low severity but high friction for new users.

maya: 2.0.1 canary published and edge smoke passed in emulators. landing stable later today.

th eo: follow-ups: add edge import smoke to sample-apps CI, include types sanity check in publish pipeline, add export-map step to release playbook.

rachel: closing loop when sample-apps matrix is green on the stable release. saved by the smoke tests :thumbsup:
